Johnston Asset Management Corp increased its stake in Occidental Pete Corp Del (OXY) by 81.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 204,570 shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.07M, up from 112,450 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Johnston Asset Management Corp who had been investing in Occidental Pete Corp Del for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $63.10B market cap company.
